subject.title: improve(ios): guide first-run users into gateway onboarding

question: Should the iOS preview/sample tour be adopted on top of the current onboarding baseline, narrowed to preview-only follow-up work, or paused/closed?
rationale: The remaining blocker is not only mechanical: current main has overlapping onboarding and routing decisions, while this PR adds a new preview/sample onboarding mode that needs maintainer product ownership.

options.title: Rebase and adopt preview tour
options.body: Keep the feature direction, but require conflict resolution, branded typography, configured-user preservation, and fresh simulator proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to preview-only follow-up
options.body: Extract only the sample-preview pieces maintainers still want and leave connection-path behavior to the current onboarding baseline.

options.title: Pause or close this branch
options.body: Treat current main's onboarding refresh as the maintained direction if the preview tour is no longer wanted.

recommendation.title: Rebase and adopt preview tour
recommendation.body: Keep the feature direction, but require conflict resolution, branded typography, configured-user preservation, and fresh simulator proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The most recent merged mobile onboarding refresh changed the same iOS onboarding and typography surfaces.
